meta.name: firecrawl-download
meta.description: Download an entire website as local files — markdown, screenshots, or multiple formats per page. Use this skill when the user wants to save a site locally, download documentation for offline use, bulk-save pages as files, or says "download the site", "save as local files", "offline copy", "download all the docs", or "save for reference". Combines site mapping and scraping into organized local directories.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将整个网站保存为本地文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把网站内容下载到本地离线查看或备份。
copy.tagline_en: Save an entire website as local files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to download a website for offline viewing or backup.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以下载整个网站到本地文件夹，每页保存为 Markdown、截图等格式，并自动整理目录结构。
howto.when: 当用户想保存网站到本地、离线查看文档、批量下载页面，或说出“下载这个网站”、“保存为本地文件”、“离线副本”等关键词时触发。

say.note: Claude 会启动交互式向导，让你选择格式和截图选项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can download an entire website to local folders, saving each page as Markdown, screenshots, or multiple formats, with organized directory structure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to save a site locally, access documentation offline, bulk-save pages, or says "download the site", "save as local files", "offline copy", etc.

say_en.note: Claude will launch the interactive wizard to pick formats and screenshots.

say_en.text: Download the /features and /sdks sections of https://docs.example.com with screenshots.
Download https://docs.example.com, save each page as Markdown and links list, max 20 pages.
